criteria_outcomes.criterion: preserve exact artifact handoffs / exact matches
avoid generic keyword matches or unrelated candidates
missing or contradictory evidence remains visible

reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage performs exact need-to-capability matching, preserves the allowed record IDs, and emits missing-safe unsupported sentinels for the two needs without matching capabilities.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: rank unsupported needs before covered needs
preserve missing or contradictory evidence visibly
deterministic ranking by upstream provenance within groups

reviews.decision_reason: prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. This labels covered needs as unsupported, pushes covered needs ahead of actually unsupported needs, and contradicts the boundary role requiring unsupported needs to rank before covered needs.

criteria_outcomes.criterion: construct recommendation from already-ranked first priority record

reviews.decision_reason: synthesize_recommendation retains the eight-item priority window and derives the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority record. The wrong final recommendation is downstream of the inverted unsupported flag supplied by prioritize_needs, not localized to this boundary.
